newsitem.title: UK: Tenderer wins 400mln stg UK helicopter school deal.
newsitem.headline: Tenderer wins 400mln stg UK helicopter school deal.

text.p: FBS Limited, a venture between FR Aviation, Bristow Helicopter Group and Serco, was picked by the UK defence ministry as preferred tenderer to provide aircraft and personnel for a helicopter flying school.
The contract will run for 15 years and is worth over 400 million stg, a statement from Cobham, which owns FR Aviation, said on Monday.
Cobham said a contract would be awarded subject to satisfactory negotiation of final terms and conditions.

FBS will provide 38 Eurocopter AS350BA Squirrel single engine and nine Bell 412 twin engine helicopters at a Royal Air Force base in Shropshire, western England and at the School of Army Aviation in Hampshire, southern England.
The programme will train pilots for all three armed services, the statement said.
Serco will be responsible for providing flight simulators and flight training ground aids.

Cobham also said the defence ministry's decision earlier this week to go ahead with the Phoenix ummanned reconnaisance aircraft would "provide significant work" for Flight Refuelling, one of its subsidiaries.
Phoenix developer GEC Marconi has carried out additional work on the aircraft to solve technical difficulties.
